reviews.decision_reason: demand_selection preserves all supplied corpus rows for this package. Every input row has demand_score >= 3, the mask is true for all 8 rows, and the selected/output table contains the same 8 records, including the two rows later treated as unsupported by capability matching. No market-demand evidence is strengthened or hidden at this boundary; it only carries forward the supplied scored needs.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve supplied needs without dropping unsupported or low-priority rows
avoid generic keyword-only market-demand inference inside selection
support deterministic downstream recommendation by preserving demand scores and order-relevant identifiers

reviews.decision_reason: evidence_normalization normalizes schema and numeric types while retaining the 8 explicit record_ids. The retained and returned needs tables match the selected needs, so missing support remains visible for downstream coverage rather than being filtered out here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact needs handoff content after normalization
keep unsupported or contradictory demand candidates visible
avoid adding independent corroboration from repeated history

reviews.decision_reason: provenance_assembly deterministically ranks the retained needs by descending demand_score with record_id tie-breaking and emits the expected 8 evidence source records. This preserves the exact provenance handoff and does not claim capability coverage or customer demand beyond the supplied scored corpus.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: avoid converting background/source metadata into unsupported market-demand proof
